jdt.
Crr No. 3156 of 2024 In Re: Abhijit Singha @ Avijit Singha Mr. Sabir Ahmed Mr. A. Saha .... For
the Petitioner
The petitioner seeks quashing of proceeding being G.R. case no. 3506 of 2024 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that a complaint was lodged by the private opposite party under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioner on 18th May, 2024 before Khardah police station wherein investigation is pending and the petitioner has been granted bail.

During pendency of the said investigation further complaint has been lodged by the private opposite party on the self-same allegation as in the earlier complaint on 24th May, 2024 before Nager Bazar police station.
The petitioner has also been granted bail in the said case.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 12 th December, 2024.
Upon completion of investigation, charge-sheet in both the cases shall not be filed without leave of this Court.
Case diary be produced on the adjourned date.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
